title: ConstraintMatch: Compositional Image-Text Matching through Constrained Regional Evidence Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.00784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local image--text matching can find strong evidence for individual concepts yet favor captions with incorrect attribute--entity bindings. We introduce ConstraintMatch, a training-free inference method that turns entity-level regional consistency into an explicit matching cost. On the same frozen condition--region similarity matrix, it compares independent crop selection for each category and attribute with a shared crop choice within each entity. Their gap quantifies the score advantage obtained by relaxing the shared-region constraint. Spatial references from the same image calibrate this gap by keeping category evidence fixed while jointly shifting an entity's attribute maps. Per-entity clipping prevents cancellation across residuals, and the scaled mean cost is subtracted from global similarity. ConstraintMatch uses pooled embeddings, and spatial calibration requires no additional encoder calls. With parameters fixed per backbone ac

translated_title: ConstraintMatch：通过受限区域证据选择实现组合式图文匹配
translated_abstract: 局部图文匹配能够为单个概念找到强有力的证据，却容易偏向属性-实体绑定错误的描述文本。我们提出ConstraintMatch，这是一种免训练的推理方法，将实体级的区域一致性转化为显式的匹配代价。在同一个冻结的条件-区域相似度矩阵上，该方法将每个类别和属性各自独立选择的裁剪区域，与每个实体内部共享的裁剪区域选择进行比较。两者之间的差距量化了放松共享区域约束所带来的分数优势。来自同一图像的空间参照通过在联合平移实体属性图的同时保持类别证据固定，来校准这一差距。逐实体的截断处理防止了残差之间的相互抵消，缩放后的平均代价从全局相似度中扣除。ConstraintMatch使用池化嵌入，且空间校准无需额外的编码器调用。
tldr: ConstraintMatch是一种免训练的推理方法，通过比较实体内共享区域与独立区域选择之间的分数差距，将实体级区域一致性转化为显式匹配代价，从而修正图文匹配中属性-实体绑定错误的问题。
en_tdlr: ConstraintMatch is a training-free inference method that converts entity-level regional consistency into an explicit matching cost by comparing independent crop selections with shared crop choices within each entity, thereby correcting incorrect attribute-entity bindings in image-text matching.
